name: Resistance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw.
effect: +1d4 to every saving throw for 10 rounds (concentration). Cast on yourself or an ally.
notes: In combat: +1d4 to saving throws (yours or an ally's) for 10 rounds, including concentration saves. Concentration.
